title: mentha aquatica var. pusilla
intro: Mentha aquatica var. pusilla, commonly known as dwarf water mint, is a compact variety of the water mint plant, characterized by its small, rounded leaves and purple flowers. It has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including digestive problems, nausea, and headaches, due to its health benefits in reducing inflammation and improving circulation. The therapeutic actions of Mentha aquatica var. pusilla include its antispasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic properties, which contribute to its use in treating respiratory issues and wounds. The bioactive constituents of this plant include menthone, menthyl acetate, and limonene, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and aroma.
